The build process uses `qmake6` and `make`, which are standard tools for Qt-based applications, and installs files into appropriate system directories under `${pkgdir}`.

All operations are confined to expected packaging tasks: compiling the source, installing desktop files, icons, appdata, and the binary. No files are written outside the package directory, and no system modifications are performed.

The maintainer and contributors are listed normally, and while the email format uses obfuscation (e.g., "dot sh"), this is a common practice to avoid spam and not inherently malicious. Overall, the PKGBUILD adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and shows no signs of malicious intent or supply-chain compromise.
